title: 第1章 少年江玄第2章第3章 藏书阁
lines: 元武皇朝，天水郡。
一片竹林深处，一名少年正在修炼。
少年口中发出低喝，双手不断的变幻着各种姿势，朝着前方的那片竹林攻去。
“嘭嘭嘭！”
低沉的闷响不断在竹林间回荡着。
他的动作行云流水，潇洒而自然，一看便是经常练习。
只是若是有武道修行者在此的话，便会发现这少年的拳头虽然刚劲有力，却并没有一丝灵气的波动。
少年汗流浃背，稚嫩清秀的脸庞却是透着一股倔强。
“我需要再努力一点，就能够突破武道的桎梏，凝聚灵脉，踏入开脉境一重。”
“到时侯我就能够参加江家的月试，将那些看不起我的主脉弟子一个个踩在脚下。”
少年名叫江玄，乃是江家的一名支脉子弟。
在每年，江家都会从几大支脉中各挑选出几名有天赋的少年郎，送往江家主脉修行，为江家注入新鲜的血液。
一年前，江玄幸运的成为了那被挑中的对象，和他青梅竹马的江雪高高兴兴来到了天水郡。
然而当他到了这里，他才发现原本在小镇中素有天才之名的他在这里却不过是大家口中的废物。
而且，最让他难以接受的是，当初与他一同前来的江雪似乎也发现了他在本族中的尴尬地位，后来竟然直接离开了他，和江家一位颇有声望，名为江天逸的主脉子弟走在一起。
一声巨响，只见面前的青竹竟被拦腰折断，江玄双目中似有怒火升腾。
这一切的屈辱，总有一天他会一一将它讨回来。
修炼结束后，江玄并没有直接回去，而是在林间徘徊着。
他想要寻找到一株名为风阳草的天材地宝，这是为他妹妹所准备的。
他的妹妹江灵儿，自打出生以来，便经常受到寒气的侵扰，全身冰寒入骨，父母为此也是操碎了心。
为了能够治疗妹妹的疾病，爹娘曾经去过很多地方寻找治病的良方。
然而三年前，爹娘那一次外出之后竟然便再也没回来过，听说有人最后一次见到爹娘，是在一处名为擎天宗府的地方。
据说那是一个比整个元武皇朝，都要更为悠久的武道宗门，根本不是现在的自己所能够接触得了的。
不过，江玄不会放弃。
这一次他来到天水郡，最主要的目的便是在江家主脉中获得一席之地，因为只有这样他才能获得更好的修炼资源，从而提升修为，为后面进入擎天宗府打下基础。
而在这之前，他需要先行通过江家的月试，否则到时他就会被遣返回原来的小镇。
“时间越来越紧张了。”
江玄不由握紧了拳头。
半个时辰后，这片竹林也是渐渐变得热闹了起来。
这片竹林是江家所管辖的范围，因为这里灵气充裕的缘故，所以每天清晨，许多江家子弟都会选择到这里感悟修行。
此刻，他们看见了独立徘徊在林间的江玄，顿时议论纷纷了起来。
“是江玄！是那个来自支脉的废物！”
content_en:
Yuanwu Dynasty, Tianshui County.
Deep in a bamboo forest, a young man was practicing.
"Drink!"
The young man let out a low shout, his hands constantly changing various postures, and attacking the bamboo forest in front of him.
"Bang bang bang!"
The low muffled sound continued to echo in the bamboo forest.
His movements are smooth and natural, and you can tell he has practiced them regularly.
But if there are martial arts practitioners here, they will find that although the young man's fist is strong and powerful, there is no fluctuation of spiritual energy.
The boy was sweating profusely, but his young and delicate face showed a hint of stubbornness.
"I need to work harder to break through the shackles of martial arts, condense my spiritual veins, and step into the first level of the pulse opening realm."
"At that time, I will be able to participate in the Jiang family's monthly examination and trample under my feet one by one the main disciples who look down on me."
The young man's name is Jiang Xuan, and he is a branch of the Jiang family.
Every year, the Jiang family selects several talented young men from each of the major branches and sends them to the main branch of the Jiang family to practice, injecting fresh blood into the Jiang family.
A year ago, Jiang Xuan was lucky enough to be the chosen one, and he happily came to Tianshui County with his childhood sweetheart Jiang Xue.
However, when he arrived here, he discovered that he, who was known as a genius in the small town, was just a waste in everyone's mouth.
Moreover, what was most difficult for him to accept was that Jiang Xue, who came with him at the beginning, seemed to have discovered his embarrassing position in the clan, and later left him directly and went with a well-known main lineage member of the Jiang family named Jiang Tianyi.
"Bang!"
There was a loud noise, and the green bamboo in front of him was broken at the waist, and Jiang Xuan's eyes seemed to be filled with anger.
All this humiliation, one day he will get it back one by one.
After the training, Jiang Xuan did not go back directly, but wandered in the forest.
He wanted to find a natural treasure called Fengyang Grass, which was prepared for his sister.
His younger sister, Jiang Ling'er, has been constantly exposed to cold air since she was born, and her whole body is freezing to the bone. Her parents are also worried about this.
In order to treat my sister's disease, my parents went to many places to find a cure.
However, three years ago, my parents went out and never came back. I heard that the last time someone saw my parents was in a place called Qingtian Sect Mansion.
It is said that it is a martial arts sect that is older than the entire Yuanwu Dynasty, and is simply beyond the reach of me now.
However, Jiang Xuan will not give up.
This time he came to Tianshui County, and his main purpose was to gain a place in the main line of the Jiang family, because only in this way could he obtain better training resources, thereby improving his cultivation and laying the foundation for entering the Qingtian Sect.
Before that, he needs to pass the Jiang family's monthly examination, otherwise he will be sent back to his original town.
"Time is getting tight."
Jiang Xuan couldn't help but clenched his fists.
Half an hour later, the bamboo forest gradually became lively.
This bamboo forest is under the jurisdiction of the Jiang family. Because it is rich in spiritual energy, many Jiang family disciples choose to come here to gain spiritual enlightenment and practice every morning.
At this moment, they saw Jiang Xuan wandering alone in the forest, and they immediately started talking.
"It's Jiang Xuan! It's that trash from the branch!"
